name: edulazaro/larachat
description: A website chat for Laravel that a bot answers and you can take over: retrieval over your own pages (JSON or Meilisearch), a cheap model that turns away off-topic questions before the expensive one is called, deterministic guards against prompt injection and abuse, lead capture, a private inbox to read and reply, and email or Telegram alerts.

suggest.edulazaro/larameili: Required for the meilisearch knowledge driver (larachat.knowledge.driver = 'meilisearch'). The json driver needs nothing.
